notes: Lending.csproj has GenerateDocumentationFile and TreatWarningsAsErrors, so every public type and member (class, constructor, methods, properties) needs an XML doc comment or the build fails with CS1591. A good solution documents each public member with a real summary (and params/returns/exception where useful), matching the existing files. Circumvention: NoWarn or WarningsNotAsErrors in the csproj, #pragma warning disable CS1591, SuppressMessage, or an .editorconfig / Directory.Build.props that downgrades the diagnostic.
